# T-1: Constrain preset registry

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make preset chain resolution depend on builtin base and enabled plugin registry entries only.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Resolver no longer imports or scans bundled official preset plugin content.
- Non-base preset resolution fails without an enabled provider entry.
- Base remains available as builtin content.

## Implementation Notes
Focus on `src/lib/presets.js` and registry integration. Remove project-local leaf override from runtime resolution paths.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local unit tests for R1/R2 resolver behavior with generic plugin fixture presets.
